source: C. Xia, L. Chen, R. Xu, M. Cao, D. Chen and Q. Fang, 'Experimental and numerical studies on ground shock generated by large equivalent surface explosions', Applied Sciences 12 (2022) 7987, doi:10.3390/app12167987, CC BY 4.0. Derived numbers only, read from its Figures 5a and 6a.

test.charge: 1 t of TNT on the ground (50 kg cast TNT initiating 950 kg of bulk TNT in nylon bags), on sand and gravel; the Gobi desert, Alxa, on hard fine alluvial and pluvial sediments
test.gauges: 3-axis piezoelectric accelerometers (1B314E, 0-500 m/s2, 0.5-7000 Hz) and a magnetoelectric velocity sensor (2A101E) in one box in a pit 0.5 m deep, at 21 and 42 m; X east, Y south, Z vertical

soilFromPaper.seismicVelocityNote: fitted by the authors to the two peak accelerations through UFC 3-340-01's direct-induced relation (with n = 2.55), not measured by travel time
soilFromPaper.densityNote: the authors' numerical model's, from laboratory tests on a high-density sand elsewhere (their ref. 27); not measured at the site

test.timeZero: not stated; the records' first motion is at about 12 ms (21 m) and 5 ms (42 m), and the velocity record's at about 290 ms, so arrival times cannot be compared

velocityGauge21m.note: Figure 7: the velocity sensor at 21 m clipped at about 0.085 m/s for about 60 ms; its component is not stated. The 42 m sensor's cable was cut. The integrated accelerations reach only about 0.03-0.05 m/s horizontally at 21 m, so the two records disagree.

method: The figures are vector drawings in the PDF. Each curve's stroked segments (pdftocairo SVG) inside the plot, the legend masked, mapped through least-squares lines through the axes' major tick marks (residuals under 0.03 ms and 0.006 m/s2). Dashed and dash-dotted curves are joined linearly across their gaps; the histories here are resampled every 0.25 ms. The digitised extremes match the values printed on the figures within 0.2 m/s2 (21 m) and 0.04 m/s2 (42 m). Velocities are the accelerations integrated, the pre-event offset of each record removed; the bounds take it removed and not.
